notes: Gold jewellery VAT is no longer a %: from FY2026-27 BAJUS prices are VAT-inclusive with a fixed Tk 2,500 per bhori, so vatJewelryPct is null. Commercial gold duty is also specific (BDT 2,000 per 11.664g, NBR Ch.71), not a %. Making min 6% (BAJUS). Used gold: 9% exchange deduction, 15% outright purchase. No dealer bar-by-size list found, so bar premium/buyback are null.
